name: Anhedonia Mukiryoku to Koukishin
original_name: アンヘドニア 無気力と好奇心
source:
Kouta Maeda felt his life was lacking.
He had an encounter with fate.
A girl who lives in the ethereal between-ness of worlds entrusted him with the destination.
Entrusted you. Where will you go?

The time is present day.
The setting, a traditional Japanese private school.
An open rooftop, a variety of clubs.

Kouta wants to know love.
He's not a fool and he's not too serious. He knows his preference.
"I thought I just liked the idea. Now I know there's nothing
more important. My own apathy was a wall and now I've hit it.
But..."

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE111381.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
前田康太感到自己的生活有所缺失。
他与命运有了一次邂逅。
一个生活在虚幻世界之间的女孩将目的地托付给他。
托付给你了。你要去哪里？

时间是现在。
背景是一所传统的日本私立学校。
开放的屋顶，各种俱乐部。

幸太想了解爱情。
他不是傻子，也不是太认真。他知道自己的喜好。
“我以为我只是喜欢这个主意。现在我知道没有什么了
更重要的是。我自己的冷漠是一堵墙，现在我已经撞到了它。
但是……”

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE111381.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
